name: Romeo R1
summary: Romeo R1 is HHS Robotics’ modular bipedal humanoid platform for research, teaching and application development. Its head, torso and limbs use standardized interfaces that support disassembly and system integration. The manufacturer describes dynamic walking and balance control, ROS/ROS2-compatible software and an OLED head display for human–robot interaction. The official image depicts the research edition; current shipment availability is unverified.
